mapper.select: SELECT mc.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(mc.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , mc.TR_CD , mc.FUND_CD , mc.TRUSTEE , mc.CURRENCY , mc.BFIL_AEK , mc.UP_AEK , mc.DW_AEK , mc.WON_BFIL_AEK , mc.WON_UP_AEK , mc.WON_DW_AEK , mc.WON_BFIL_HWAN_CHA , mc.WON_HWAN_CHA , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , #{workdate} AS workdate , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , COALESCE(mc.FCUR_BFIL_AEK, 0) + COALESCE(mc.FCUR_UP_AEK, 0) - COALESCE(mc.FCUR_DW_AEK, 0) AS fcur_aek , mc.FCUR_HWAN_CHA AS syt0mc_fcur_hwan_cha FROM SYT0MC mc JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = mc.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = mc.FUND_CD WHERE mc.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND mc.TR_YMD >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') - 1 ORDER BY mc.TR_YMD ASC , mc.FUND_CD ASC , mc.TR_CD ASC , mc.TRUSTEE ASC , mc.CURRENCY ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd FROM SYT0MC t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY ymd
